infra:Foundations.evidence: astryx/astryx.tamber (251 tokens) and tokens/themes.tamber (8 themes, 1,066 per-theme values), imported by Exact's own `contract tamber import astryx`; gallery case foundations-0001 on web and Linux.
infra:Foundations.notes: 279 of 286 resolved tokens map; 7 do not (duration min/max tiers, focus outline style). The 4 motion tokens cannot vary by theme (Tamber writes a duration or easing into its transition at build), so every theme uses the default theme's motion. A type role (`font`) varies by theme, so it must sit on each text, not on a container. Number and date formatting stay en-US in Contract (a data module would localise, but the Linux build carries none).

VisuallyHidden.notes: Contract refuses clip-path inset(); a 1 px clipped box stands in.

SizeContext.notes: No context through a slot: size is a prop each child takes.

InteractiveRoleContext.notes: No context through a slot: role is a prop.

Text.notes: `font` takes only literals, so the type role is a chain of literals. No inline-flex. `textWrap` keeps auto/balance plus nowrap; `pretty` is refused. Truncation tooltip waits for Tooltip (wave 4).

Icon.evidence: astryx/icons.contract (29 icons from defaultIcons.tsx as one path each); gallery icon-*
Icon.notes: Contract expands a component at each use, so a branch per icon repeated all 29 icons at every Icon: one path chosen by a function keeps Icon small. Custom icon registry (registerIcons) has no Contract equivalent: icons are known at build.

Spinner.notes: Turn is a CSS keyframe; reduced motion not yet wired.

Kbd.notes: Mod shows as the Command sign on every platform for now.

Divider.notes: isFullBleed needs the container's padding, which Contract cannot read (no runtime CSS variables): ignored.

Link.notes: Hover underline thickness refused (a state row paints only); hover dims instead. LinkProvider (router swap) is Contract's own `link`/routes.

Avatar.notes: Initials use the first letter of the first and last words (no Unicode-aware search). Image fallbackSrc and load error not yet wired. Tooltip waits for wave 4.

AvatarGroup.notes: Members are data (AvatarItem[]), not child elements: one slot cannot be counted.
